title: Pixel Grid Hover
build_command: npm ci && npm run build (Node 22; Docker equivalent in README.md)

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite, dist/index.html exists

notes: Uses React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 3, Framer Motion 12; dependency lockfile included.
All specified Pexels photos and Google DM Sans 400/500 files retrieved and served locally.
Provided reference shows floating squares on a blank field; full written prompt used for page content and layout. No screenshot used as webpage content.
CTA and plus signs have no navigation destination in the prompt; specified visual and hover behavior implemented without invented contact workflow.
Browser validation uses Chromium. Touch viewport checked for layout and asset loading; hover behavior checked with desktop pointer.
